description: Plot taxonomic distribution and compute non-metazoan fraction
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
tot=16867
data={"Metazoa\n(10,575; 62.7%)":10575,"Viridiplantae\n(2,691; 16.0%)":2691,
      "Fungi\n(2,667; 15.8%)":2667,"Other euk.\n(934; 5.5%)":16867-10575-2691-2667}
colors=["#7570b3","#1b9e77","#d95f02","#999999"]
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6,6))
ax.pie(data.values(),labels=data.keys(),colors=colors,autopct="",startangle=90,
       wedgeprops={"edgecolor":"white"})
ax.set_title("PTHR10782 (PIAS) taxonomic distribution\n16,867 proteins, strictly eukaryotic (0 Bacteria/Archaea)\n~37% NON-metazoan → metazoan STAT/transcription terms cannot be family-wide")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("pias_taxonomy.png",dpi=120)
nonmet=16867-10575
print(f"Non-metazoan: {nonmet} = {100*nonmet/16867:.1f}% of family")
print(f"Fungi+plants: {2667+2691} = {100*(2667+2691)/16867:.1f}% (chromatin CC most questionable here)")
print("Bacteria/Archaea: 0 -> strictly eukaryotic (consistent with SUMO being eukaryote-specific)")
